description_en: Modifies the notification recipient of a project
name: ModifyProjectNotifyReceiver

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID。
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the notification recipient.
You can call the ListProjectNotifyReceivers operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知接收人ID。
您可以调用ListProjectNotifyReceivers接口获取该参数
parameters.name: receiver_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the notification recipient. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, cannot start with a special character, and can contain only the following special characters: periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), backslashes (), and spaces.
If this parameter is not specified, the name remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后的消息通知接收人名称。长度为1-128个字符，不能以特殊字符开头，只可包含特殊字符中的'.'、'_'、'-'、'\'以及空格。
未填则表示不做修改
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The new phone number of the notification recipient
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的消息通知接收人手机号
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en: The new email address of the notification recipient
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的消息通知接收人邮箱
parameters.name: email

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
